name: admin_state
desc: The administrative state of the object or policy. - Choices: `enabled`, `disabled`

name: dai_interfaces
desc: List of Dynamic ARP Inspection interfaces. - Map key: `interface_id` - Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1`.

name: dai_vlans
desc: List of VLANs with Dynamic ARP Inspection enabled (`ip arp inspection vlan`). Requires the `arp-ether` TCAM region. - Map key: `vlan_id` - DAI Vlan Number. - Key range: `0`-`65535`

name: dai_vlans[*].log_type
desc: Log All/Permit/None DAI on Vlan matching DHCP Bindings. - Choices: `deny`, `permit`, `all`, `inone`

name: deletion_policy

name: device
desc: A device name from the provider configuration.

name: ip_source_guard_excluded_vlans
desc: List of VLANs excluded from IP Source Guard (`ip dhcp snooping ipsg-excluded vlan`). - Map key: `vlan_id` - Vlan Number to be ecluded from IPSG. - Key range: `0`-`65535`

name: ip_source_guard_interfaces
desc: List of IP Source Guard interfaces (`ip verify source dhcp-snooping-vlan`). Requires the `ipsg` TCAM region. - Map key: `interface_id` - Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1`.

desc: The administrative state of the object or policy. - Choices: `enabled`, `disabled`

name: relay_dai
desc: Dynamic ARP Inspection functionality with DHCP Relay is enabled.

name: relay_information_option_server_id_override
desc: Relay Information Option Server-id-override-disable Enabled. - Range: `0`-`1`

name: relay_interfaces
desc: List of DHCP relay interfaces. - Map key: `interface_id` - Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1`.

name: relay_interfaces[*].addresses
desc: List of DHCP relay addresses. - Map key format: `<vrf>;<address>` - Key component `vrf`: vrf in which the dhcp server is present. Valid only when the client is in a different vrf from the server vrf. - Key component `address`: IPv4 or IPv6 address.

name: relay_interfaces[*].ipv6_addresses
desc: List of DHCPv6 relay addresses. - Map key format: `<vrf>;<address>;<destination_interface>` - Key component `vrf`: VRF. Use `!unspecified` if no VRF is configured. - Key component `address`: v6 Address. - Key component `destination_interface`: Destination Interface. name: relay_sub_option_format_non_tlv
desc: Relay Option82 Sub-Option Format Non-TLV Enabled.

name: snooping_interfaces
desc: List of DHCP snooping interfaces. - Map key: `interface_id` - Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1`.

name: snooping_sub_option_format_non_tlv
desc: Snooping Option82 Sub-Option Format Non-TLV Enabled.

name: snooping_vlans
desc: List of VLANs with DHCP snooping enabled (`ip dhcp snooping vlan`). - Map key: `vlan_id` - Snoop Vlan Number. - Key range: `0`-`65535`
